references.text: Jesus criticizes the scribes for exploiting widows' property and offering long prayers to display piety, similar to the criticism in Mark.
Similar to the criticism Jesus gives in Mark about scribes who exploit widows and their lengthy prayers.
The prophet Isaiah criticizes leaders in Israel for injustice toward widows, paralleling Jesus' criticism of the scribes in Mark.
The Mosaic law warns against perverting justice for a widow, which mirrors Jesus' criticism of the actions of the scribes.
